title: Spectral-probing affinity canary with KV-preserving spillback and tenant hedges
creator: Ravi Narayanan
description: Design and implement an affinity-driven canary strategy that uses lightweight spectral probes to estimate cross-variant compatibility while preserving KV/prefix cache state during spillback. The feature targets multi-variant deployments that span heterogeneous regions and capacity tiers. Goals: reduce false-positive degradations from cold-cache variance, enable safe tenant-prioritized failover, and provide automated rollback triggers that consider both correctness signals and cache-warmth metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Canary rollout can be scoped to tenant affinity buckets and tracked independently
Spectral probe runs return compatibility scores within < 60ms median additional latency
Spillback preserves per-tenant KV cache prefixes where model interfaces are compatible
Automated rollback triggers when combined anomaly score (latency P95, semantic-regression, and cache-eviction-rate) exceeds threshold
New metrics visible in Console per-model and per-tenant: compatibility_score, cache_warmth_index, spectral_probe_latency
design_decisions: Use short-lived spectral probes: 3–10 synthetic requests per minute per canary lane to estimate semantic compatibility without exposing customers to traffic risk
Affinity buckets computed from hashing tenant_id + recent latency footprint to keep probe distribution representative
Preserve KV prefixes on spillback only when model metadata indicates identical tokenizer/schema and tokenization seed; otherwise invalidate to avoid silent misbehavior
Tiered capacity awareness: prefer same-tier spillback; if unavailable, route to nearest-compatible tier with degraded mode flag
Rollback decision computed as composite score: 50% semantic regression signal (eval set comparisons), 30% latency degradation (P95 relative), 20% cache-warmth drop; each with tunable thresholds
tradeoffs_and_risks: Extra probes add marginal load; mitigated by sampling and probabilistic bucketing
Preserving stale KV prefixes risks semantic drift if underlying model semantics changed; mitigated by strict compatibility metadata checks and short TTLs
Affinity bucketing increases routing complexity and state; requires small consistent-hash table per region
Cross-region spillback may increase latency but preserves availability — must be surfaced clearly in SLA docs
implementation_notes: New spectral probe service running as lightweight sidecar in routing plane (Go) that emits compatibility_score and probe_latency metrics
Extend model manifest with 'compatibility_fingerprint' and 'tokenizer_checksum' fields
Routing layer to maintain per-tenant affinity maps and offset eviction lanes for warmed prefixes
KV-preservation toggles exposed as a rollout flag (default off) until early experiments validate safety
Add gating in admission controller to block KV-preservation if model manifests mismatch
test_plan: Unit tests for spectral probe parser and compatibility heuristics
Integration: synthetic canary experiment with controlled semantic regression to validate composite rollback score
Chaos test: induce region outage and validate spillback preserves warmed prefixes for compatible tenants
Performance: end-to-end probe overhead measured under 10k QPS canonical workload
Safety: staged opt-in with internal tenants before wide release
rollout_plan: Phase 0 — feature flags only: deploy routing changes behind ff, probes disabled
Phase 1 — internal canaries: enable spectral probes for Redwood internal tenants, KV-preservation off
Phase 2 — tenant-affinity canaries: enable affinity bucketing and probes on small subset of customers, monitor metrics for 72h
Phase 3 — KV-preservation opt-in: enable preservation for verified model pairs and a small tenant cohort
Phase 4 — automated rollback: enable composite rollback decisions in non-blocking mode (alerts only), iterate thresholds
Phase 5 — full automation: enable auto-rollback and widen rollout incrementally
metrics: semantic_regression_rate (relative BLEU/embedding-sim decline on eval set)
observability_and_alerting: Dashboards: per-model canary lane with compatibility_score trend and breakdown by affinity bucket
Alerting: composite_score > 0.7 for 3 consecutive windows triggers PagerDuty
Tracing: tag probe-origin and tenant-affinity in traces to aid RCA
Audit log: record spillback decisions, preserved prefixes, and manifest fingerprints
